template_meta.name: Cost_Comparison_Headline_Hero
template_meta.description: A giant black stat-comparison headline dominates the top half of a pure white canvas ('Problem costs $X. Product costs $Y.'), followed by a short benefit paragraph, a bold pill CTA button, and a floating product shot anchored bottom-right. Brand logo is composited into the top-left corner as a post-processing overlay (not part of the generative prompt) to guarantee pixel-exact brand treatment.

post_processing.logo_overlay: Do NOT ask the image model to render the logo from a text description — across repeated attempts it reliably drops or distorts fine brand treatment (thin white letter outline, soft drop shadow, sparkle accent) and can also destabilize unrelated elements (headline clipping, body copy reflow) when the logo instruction is lengthened to describe those details. Instead: generate the ad with the TOP region left as plain white space, then composite {user_inputs.logo_image} on top via direct image overlay (e.g. ffmpeg 'overlay' filter or Canva). If the source logo asset does not already include the white outline/shadow/sparkle treatment, apply it in the compositing step, not the generative prompt. Anchor left-aligned, ~8% left margin, sized to roughly 22-26% of canvas width within the 0-6% height band.

user_inputs.body_copy: No scaffolding. No scrubbing. No weekend lost to a water blaster. Just spray, sit back, and let Wet & Forget's bleach-free formula tackle moss, mould, lichen and algae, while you get on with your life.
user_inputs.typography: Metric Bold (headlines/CTA), Metric Regular (body copy) — heavy-weight grotesk sans-serif

rendering.style: official wordmark, unaltered colors, thin white letter outline, soft black drop shadow behind (30% opacity, 40% blur), small sparkle accent top-right

elements.render_note: Render this exact sentence ONE TIME ONLY, word for word, in order, with no repeated, dropped, or duplicated phrases anywhere in the sentence.

rendering.style: photorealistic studio product shot, slight upward tilt, MUST preserve the exact real-world silhouette from the reference product photo — do not substitute or simplify the bottle shape (e.g. a 5-litre jerry-can body must keep its integrated carry handle)
rendering.lighting: soft diffused studio light, key top-right

generative_image_prompt: A 1080x1350px (4:5) vertical ad on a pure white (#FFFFFF) background, high-contrast infographic-style layout, top to bottom. Use ONLY the brand's official palette throughout (do not introduce any other colors) and set all text in the brand's heavy-weight grotesk sans-serif (bold for headline/CTA, regular for body copy). Render every word of every text block exactly as written, with no dropped, duplicated, or rearranged words. TOP (0-6% height): leave this band as plain background — the logo is composited afterward as a post-processing overlay, not rendered by the image model. HEADLINE BLOCK (10-58% height, dominates the canvas): huge bold headline (font-weight 900, tight line-height ~1.02, slight negative letter-spacing), left-aligned with an 8% left margin, wrapping across multiple lines, reading exactly: '{user_inputs.problem_label} costs {user_inputs.comparison_audience} {user_inputs.problem_cost}. {user_inputs.brand_name} starts from {user_inputs.product_cost}.' All headline text pure black (#000000), no color variation. A small subtle quotation mark in black (#000000) at low opacity sits just below-right of the headline block as a quiet decorative flourish. BODY COPY (60-70% height): smaller regular-weight text in black (#000000), left-aligned, 8% left margin, max width 62% of canvas. Render this exact sentence ONE TIME ONLY, word for word, in order, with no repeated or duplicated phrases anywhere in the sentence: '{user_inputs.body_copy}'. CTA + PRODUCT ROW (73-85% height): a pill-shaped button filled with the brand accent color on the left (8% margin), roughly one-third canvas width, with bold white all-caps text '{user_inputs.cta_text}' centered inside it. To the right of the button, a photorealistic studio shot of {user_inputs.product_name} floating at a slight upward tilt, soft diffused studio lighting with a key light top-right, soft contact shadow beneath it, slightly overflowing/breaking the top edge of this row. The product MUST keep its exact real-world silhouette from the reference product photo — do not substitute or simplify its shape. BADGE LINE (87-92% height): small bold text in the brand's secondary color, left-aligned, reading '{user_inputs.badge_text}'. No footer or fine-print disclaimer. Overall mood: clean, bold, high-contrast, stat-driven attention-grabber, strictly brand-palette color use only. Output: 1080x1350px, 4:5 aspect ratio, RGB, sharp vector-like typography, photorealistic product rendering.
notes_for_next_time: Gemini text rendering on longer body-copy sentences is prone to dropping/duplicating words. Fix: keep sentences simple (avoid embedded em-dash clauses) and add an explicit 'render this exact sentence ONE TIME ONLY... no repeated or duplicated phrases' instruction.

Product shape fidelity (e.g. a jerry-can's integrated handle) can drift or get simplified away. Fix: explicitly instruct the model to preserve the exact real-world silhouette from the reference photo and name the specific distinguishing feature (the handle) that must not be lost.

Asking the model to render a brand logo with specific fine treatment (thin white outline + drop shadow + sparkle accent) is unreliable — across 3 regeneration attempts it either dropped the outline, or introduced unrelated regressions elsewhere on the canvas (literal layout-label text rendered as copy, headline clipping, body copy reflow) when the logo instruction was lengthened. Fix: leave the logo band blank in the generative prompt and composite the real logo asset file on top afterward (image overlay / Canva), matching the existing pattern already used in template keetrax-20260803-00002.

Always confirm which logo asset is current before generating — Wet & Forget uses the 2025-rebrand gradient wordmark (blue-to-navy gradient text, red gradient ampersand), stored at clients/wet-and-forget/assets/logo-wf.png. The old flat-color logo is kept at logo-wf-old.png for reference only and should not be used.
